---
title: "Install"
---

MINERVA Space Echo runs on macOS 11 or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, as an **Audio Unit** and a
**VST3**. It is aimed at Ableton Live but works in any AU or VST3 host.

## Download

Tagged versions are published on the [Releases page](https://github.com/CrumpLab/MinervaSpaceEcho/releases).
For the newest build from any branch, open the repository's
[Actions tab](https://github.com/CrumpLab/MinervaSpaceEcho/actions/workflows/build.yml), pick a green `build`
run and download the **MinervaSpaceEcho-macOS** artifact (you need to be signed in to GitHub).

Either way you get two files:

| File | Use it to |
|---|---|
| `MinervaSpaceEcho-<version>-macOS.pkg` | Install the AU and VST3 into `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins` (you can untick either). |
| `MinervaSpaceEcho-<version>-macOS.zip` | Copy the plug-in bundles by hand. |

### With the installer

Double-click the `.pkg` and follow the steps.

::: {.callout-note}
## If macOS won't open it
Builds that aren't signed with an Apple Developer ID are blocked the first time. Open **System Settings →
Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**, then run the installer again.
:::

### By hand

Unzip the `.zip`, then in Terminal, from the unzipped folder:

```sh
cp -R "MINERVA Space Echo.component" ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
cp -R "MINERVA Space Echo.vst3"      ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
# Remove the download quarantine (needed for builds without Developer ID signing):
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/"MINERVA Space Echo.component"
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/"MINERVA Space Echo.vst3"
```

## Set up Live

1. **Live → Settings → Plug-Ins**.
2. Turn on **Use Audio Units v2** and/or **Use VST3 Plug-In System Folders**.
3. Click **Rescan**.
4. In the browser, under **Plug-Ins → CrumpLab**, you'll find **MINERVA Space Echo**.

::: {.callout-tip}
## AU or VST3?
They sound identical. Use the **VST3** if you want to trigger actions with MIDI notes from a clip
([MIDI and automation](../guide/midi.qmd)); hosts don't send notes to AU audio effects. Everything else,
including MIDI-mapping the parameters, works in both.
:::

## Build it yourself

You need Xcode's command-line tools and CMake 3.22 or later (`brew install cmake ninja`):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/CrumpLab/MinervaSpaceEcho.git
cd MinervaSpaceEcho
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DMSE_COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD=ON
cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build
```

The first configure downloads JUCE and Catch2. `MSE_COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD=ON` installs the AU and VST3 into
`~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins` for you. See [Development](../development.qmd) for more.

## Uninstall

Delete `MINERVA Space Echo.component` from `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components` (or
`~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components`) and `MINERVA Space Echo.vst3` from the matching `VST3` folder. Your
presets and saved memories are in `~/Music/MINERVA Space Echo`.
